To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a practical cooperative transmission scheme denotes as VMRT is proposed and evaluated using a realistic channel estimation and using low-density LDPC codes, which is robust against channel errors, offers diversity and array gains, and can be used in OFDMA-based relay-based networks.
the VMRT is a robust scheme that can be used to provide diversity and array gains, keeping the complexity and the number of antennas low.

a multiuser cooperative transmission strategy based on virtual MRT (VMRT) is robust against channel errors, it offers diversity gain, it keeps the complexity low, it provides improved performance gains when combined with LDPC codes, and it can be used to increase system throughput by extending the coverage area of OFDMA-based relaying networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a multiuser cooperative transmission system based on the MIMO-OFDM technique and the use of LDPC codes.

the development of a multiuser MIMO-OFDM-based relay system with the following features: (i) a multiuser channel estimation algorithm that can provide channel estimates for all the users and relays in a simple manner, (ii) a cooperative multiuser MIMO scheme that can exploit the diversity gains offered by the relays, and (iii) a coding scheme that can efficiently exploit the diversity and array gains provided by the relays.
the design and analysis of cooperative relay-based networks.
